name: letta-run
title: Letta Run
description: Flat structure summary of the Letta Run entity, derived from the Letta OpenAPI 1.0.0 spec.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The human-friendly ID of the Run

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: The timestamp when the run was created.

fields.name: completed_at
fields.description: The timestamp when the run was completed.

fields.name: agent_id
fields.description: The unique identifier of the agent associated with the run.

fields.name: conversation_id
fields.description: The unique identifier of the conversation associated with the run.

fields.name: base_template_id
fields.description: The base template ID that the run belongs to.

fields.name: background
fields.description: Whether the run was created in background mode.

fields.name: request_config
fields.description: The request configuration for the run.

fields.name: stop_reason
fields.description: The reason why the run was stopped.

fields.name: callback_url
fields.description: If set, POST to this URL when the run completes.

fields.name: callback_sent_at
fields.description: Timestamp when the callback was last attempted.

fields.name: callback_status_code
fields.description: HTTP status code returned by the callback endpoint.

fields.name: callback_error
fields.description: Optional error message from attempting to POST the callback endpoint.

fields.name: ttft_ns
fields.description: Time to first token for a run in nanoseconds
